definitions: To become calm, quiet, or less excited.
To start living a quiet and steady life in one place, often with a regular job and family.
To get into a comfortable position, especially in order to read or sleep.
To become accustomed to a new situation or environment.
examples: The children finally settled down after their game.
He decided it was time to settle down and get married.
She settled down with a book by the fire.
It took her a few weeks to settle down in her new job.
